description: Advisories that are known to be non-exploitable in this codebase or have no upstream fix. Each entry MUST include a reason and an expiry (ISO date). Entries past their expiry cause the audit gate to fail so they get re-reviewed.

allowlist.reason: CRLF injection in Nodemailer List-* header comments. Not exploitable here: lib/email.ts and lib/assignment-email.ts only send server-controlled headers (from/to/subject/html/text). No user input is ever passed as a List-* header. No upstream fix as of 2026-07-15.

jsonTransport bypasses disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess. Not exploitable here: lib/email.ts uses SMTP transport via nodemailer.createTransport({host, port, secure, auth, tls}) exclusively — jsonTransport is never instantiated. No upstream fix as of 2026-07-15.

Improper TLS validation in OAuth2 token fetch. Not exploitable here: SMTP auth is plain user/pass (see lib/email.ts settings.smtpUser/smtpPass). No OAuth2 flow is configured. No upstream fix as of 2026-07-15.

raw sendMail option bypasses disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess enabling arbitrary file read / SSRF. Not exploitable here: every sendMail() call in the codebase passes structured {from,to,subject,text,html} — the `raw` option is never used (verified via grep). No upstream fix as of 2026-07-15.
